title: X-Play: Aug 11, 2008
description: Adam and Morgan bring you their Review of Madden NFL 09, as well as an incredible Preview of EA's highly anticipated survival horror title, Dead Space. Also, Mr. Sark will bringing you an All Access look at Bionic Commando Rearmed and we'll unveil a new segment, The Will Wright Minute.

title: X-Play: Aug 12, 2008
description: Adam and Morgan bring you a Preview of Dark Void, as well as an incredible All Access look at id Software's highly anticipated FPS title, Wolfenstein. Also, we'll have a Hands On demo with Rise of the Argonauts.

title: X-Play: Aug 13, 2008
description: Adam and Morgan bring you their Review for the Sci-Fi RPG Space Siege for the PC, as well as an incredible All Access look at the highly anticipated MMO title, Warhammer Online: Age of Reckoning. Also, we'll have the latest available for digital delivery as we explore The Download with Bionic Commando Rearmed.

title: X-Play: Aug 14, 2008
description: Adam and Morgan devote a full episode to bringing you an early look at LucasArts highly anticipating action game Star Wars: The Force Unleashed. We'll have an All Access interview with Project Lead Hayden Blackman, as well as behind-the-scenes specials on the art, music, and tech of the eagerly awaited next chapter in the Star Wars Saga.

title: X-Play: Aug 18, 2008
description: Adam and Morgan bring you their Review for the EA sports title Madden NFL 09 All-Play for the Nintendo Wii, as well as two incredible Previews for the highly anticipated shooters, Far Cry 2 and Crysis Warhead. Also, our favorite eccentric video gamer creator/guru is back with his take on 2001 in The Will Wright Minute NOTE: Adam is not in this episode.

title: X-Play: Aug 19, 2008
description: Adam and Morgan bring you their Review for the highly anticipated action-RPG Too Human, as well as an incredible Preview for the upcoming voice-activated RTS, Tom Clancy's EndWar. Also, we'll get an incredible Hands On look at Disney Interactive's beautiful upcoming ATV racing title, Pure. NOTE: Adam is not in this episode.

title: X-Play: Oct 13, 2008
description: Adam and Morgan welcome you to Tokyo Game Show 08. In the first of four days of coverage, we'll bring you First Looks at the just announced Halo 3: Recon as well as Tenchu 4. Also, Morgan will be on the floor of TGS to get a Floor Report with SONY.

title: X-Play: Oct 14, 2008
description: Several heroes stand at major crossroads, facing personal decisions that could redefine who's "good" or "evil" -Claire attempts to take down her first new villain.

title: X-Play: Oct 20, 2008
description: Adam and Morgan bring you their Reviews for three of the most highly anticipated titles of the year, including Fable II, LittleBigPlanet, and Dead Space, as well as an All Access look at the upcoming parkour-inspired first-person action title from EA, Mirror's Edge. Also, Kristin Holt will be back with some more tips and tricks of the force in Star Wars: The Force Unleashed.

title: X-Play: Oct 27, 2008
description: Adam and Morgan bring you their All Access reports for three of the most highly anticipated titles of the year, including Prince of Persia, Left 4 Dead, and the Fallout 3 Launch Party, as well as a Hands On with Mortal Kombat vs. DC Universe. Also, Kristin Holt will be back with some more tips and tricks as she tells you have to have fun with pedestrians in Saints Row 2.

title: X-Play: Oct 29, 2008
description: Adam and Morgan bring you two major Reviews with their scores for Fallout 3 and MotorStorm: Pacific Rift. They'll also get some Face Time with the legendary Shigeru Miyamoto and give you part 2 of their All Access look at Prince of Persia. Finally, they will bring you the Broadcast Premiere of the amazing new Killzone 2 trailer.

title: X-Play: Oct 30, 2008
description: Adam and Morgan bring you their Review for Midnight Club: Los Angeles, as well as a Hands On with the highly-anticipated Tomb Raider: Underworld, while they stay Up All Night with Warhammer Online. Games in 60 Seconds will take a look at the classic: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas and Cliff Bleszinski will stop by with an all-new Cliff Notes.

title: X-Play: Nov 5, 2008
description: Adam and Morgan bring you Reviews for Resistance 2 and Guitar Hero: World Tour, as well as the second part of our interview with Miyamoto in Face Time. Also, we take another All Access look at the new Prince of Persia game.

title: X-Play: Nov 6, 2008
description: Survivors fear that "The Others" may have returned when Sun is injured during a failed kidnapping attempt. Meanwhile, Sawyer is an amused, but highly interested, bystander when tension escalates between Jack, Locke, Kate and Ana Lucia over control of the hatch computer, and the storage of the weapons.

title: X-Play: Nov 25, 2008
description: ProTip w/ Tsquared; Preview-Zero Punctuation; Preview-Upcoming Game

title: X-Play: Nov 26, 2008
description: Gaming Update-Latest News; Preview-Upcoming Game; Review-Latest Game

title: X-Play: Fallout 3 Special
description: Adam and Morgan continue their World Premiere Tuesdays by bringing you an in-depth look at the highly anticipated RPG title, Fallout 3. We'll bring you Exclusive footage, as well as interviews with Fallout 3 mastermind Todd Howard and the entire Bethesda team. World Premiere Tuesdays continue tonight!
